LISTEN-PODCAST! THE DAY JESUS CHRIST THE SON OF GOD WAS DISHONORED AND DISRESPECTED BY HIS FAMILY AND COMMUNITY IN THE JUST JESUS EVANGELISTIC CAMPAIGN #2421 MARK 6:1-4, WITH DANIEL WHYTE III, PRESIDENT OF GOSPEL LIGHT SOCIETY INTERNATIONAL, PASTOR OF GOSPEL LIGHT HOUSE OF PRAYER INTERNATIONAL “CRYING IN THE WILDERNESS,” “EXILED ON THE ISLE OF PATMOS,” AND “PREACHING THE GOSPEL BY ANY MEANS NECESSARY.”

Listen to the audio versions of this message:

MARK 6:1-4

1 And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples followed him.

2 And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

3 Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

4 But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
summary: Daniel Whyte III preaches Mark 6:1-4 in the Just Jesus Evangelistic Campaign #2421: the day Jesus Christ the Son of God was dishonored and disrespected by His own family and community.
takeaway: “But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.” — Mark 6:4
